benefits.text: BBIA Last Blush Re-new edition is a versatile blush and contour powder line that gives cheeks a natural, clear look and helps the face look slimmer and more defined. The ultra-fine powder texture is easy to blend and lasts long on the skin without feeling cakey or heavy. The palette of 15 shades is grouped by tone and function (highlight – blush – contour), suiting many makeup styles from sheer and clear to sharp and defined.

howToUse.text:
Blush: Use a brush to lightly sweep onto the cheekbones; can be applied in multiple layers to adjust intensity.
Contour: Use an angled brush to lightly blend the powder onto areas you want to visually slim, such as the jawline, nose bridge and forehead.
Highlight: Blend the highlighting powder onto the high points of the face, such as the nose bridge, tops of the cheeks and forehead.

safety.text:
For external use on the cheeks only; avoid use on scratched or irritated skin
Discontinue use if any unusual signs appear, and keep out of reach of children.
